bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 818K views on YouTube. The only paid step is R500 a month.
beats.text: Your vlogs pull 10,000 to 43,000 views each, and Edge Lab is the only thing to buy: a self-paced 30+ video course for R500 a month. That's a great way in. But there's nothing for the traders who want you, one-on-one, reviewing their trades.

beats.title: 150+ members already trade your LSD model.
beats.text: Your own site shows it: Imo taking payout after payout, Leruo and Bobby passing Phase 1 soon after joining. Add 10.5K followers on Instagram and everyone waiting to get into the free Discord. These people already trust the model.

beats.title: “WhatsApp me for mentorship” doesn't scale.
beats.text: Your Linktree says “WhatsApp Me For Trading Mentorship!”, and the free Discord starts with a WhatsApp number. So every serious conversation runs through your phone, with no way to see who's ready before you reply.

beats.title: “I want Edge Lab to stay affordable.” It does.
beats.text: The R500 course stays exactly as it is and keeps bringing people in. The 1-on-1 mentorship sits on top: one page, a short application and a call, only for members who want you reviewing their trades. The course becomes the way in, not the ceiling.
beats.quote: “Too many traders either switch strategies, get confused, or simply cant execute consistently”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.title: You switch strategies
cards.body: A few losses and you're on to the next YouTube strategy, so you never master one.

cards.title: The chart confuses you
cards.body: Zones everywhere, liquidity everywhere. You can't tell which ones actually matter.

cards.title: You can't execute consistently
cards.body: You know the model on paper. In the moment, you enter early, late, or not at all.

mechanism.title: One model: LSD
mechanism.body: Edge Lab trades one model: liquidity plus supply and demand. You learn to mark the zones that matter, separate high-quality liquidity from the traps, and execute the same entry every time with fixed risk. In the mentorship, Yug reviews your trades with you until the model is yours.

pillars.title: Liquidity
pillars.body: Spot where it sits and tell high-quality liquidity from low.

pillars.title: Supply & demand
pillars.body: Mark only the zones that matter, not every candle.

pillars.title: Entry model
pillars.body: Execute the LSD entry and avoid the traps.

pillars.title: Risk
pillars.body: Fixed risk for prop firm and personal accounts.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a few of your recent trades ready, wins and losses.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM or WhatsApp message. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Yug

preCallEmails.subject: Why one model beats five
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most traders don't fail because their strategy is bad. They fail because they switch strategies, get confused, or can't execute the same way twice.

Edge Lab runs on one model: liquidity plus supply and demand, with fixed risk on every trade.

On the call we'll look at where your execution breaks today.

Yug

preCallEmails.subject: "I already have the course"
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Good. Then you know the LSD model.

The 1-on-1 mentorship is for when the videos aren't enough anymore: I go through your own trades with you, so you see exactly where your execution is off.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Yug

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. What you want your trading to look like in a year.
3. How the mentorship works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Yug

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Yug's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Yug

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Yug
